response.sql: WITH rentals_by_rating AS (SELECT COUNT(r.rental_id) as rental_count FROM rental r JOIN inventory i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id JOIN film f ON i.film_id = f.film_id GROUP BY f.rating), overall_stats AS (SELECT AVG(rental_count) as overall_avg FROM rentals_by_rating) SELECT AVG(rbr.rental_count) as avg_above_average, AVG(rbr.rental_count) - os.overall_avg as above_average_by FROM rentals_by_rating rbr CROSS JOIN overall_stats os WHERE rbr.rental_count > os.overall_avg
